# NICABM (National Institute for the Clinical Application of Behavioral Medicine)

> NICABM provides accredited clinical training and continuing education for mental health professionals in evidence-based trauma treatment, neurodiversity-affirming care, and specialized clinical interventions.

NICABM is a leading provider of CE/CME-accredited training programs for psychologists, therapists, and mental health professionals. Founded and directed by Dr. Ruth Buczynski, the organization specializes in trauma-informed clinical practice, behavioral medicine, and contemporary mental health treatment approaches. All programs feature expert instructors and are designed for licensed mental health practitioners seeking professional development.

## Key Topics

- trauma treatment
- continuing education (CE/CME credits)
- clinical training
- evidence-based practice
- behavioral medicine
- neurodiversity-affirming care
- attachment neurobiology
- dissociation and trauma-related parts
- ADHD in adults
- perinatal OCD
- narcissism treatment
- abandonment trauma
- core beliefs and self-worth
- mental health professionals
- Dr. Ruth Buczynski

## Advanced Master Programs

- [The Advanced Master Program on the Treatment of Trauma](https://www.nicabm.com/program/master-program-on-treating-trauma): NICABM's 5-module advanced master program on trauma treatment with accredited certification
- [Mastering the Treatment of Trauma](https://www.nicabm.com/program/mastering-the-treatment-of-trauma): Dr. Ruth Buczynski's in-depth trauma therapy training covering 5 critical issues in clinical practice

## Specialized Clinical Training Programs

- [The Neurobiology of Attachment - NICABM](https://www.nicabm.com/program/attachment): NICABM course with 5 trauma experts on attachment neurobiology and trauma healing strategies
- [Neurodiversity-Affirming Care for Autistic Clients](https://www.nicabm.com/program/neurodiversity-autism-3): NICABM clinical training on neurodiversity-affirming care for autistic clients with CE/CME credits
- [A Clinician's Comprehensive Guide to ADHD in Adults](https://www.nicabm.com/program/adult-adhd-frank-1): Michelle Frank's clinical guide to adult ADHD with continuing education credits for mental health professionals
- [Perinatal OCD: Differential Diagnosis and Evidence-Based Treatment](https://www.nicabm.com/program/perinatal-ocd-yip-1): Jenny Yip's evidence-based clinical training on perinatal OCD diagnosis and treatment with CE credits

## Trauma and Dissociation Training

- [Embracing Our Fragmented Selves: Working with Trauma-Related Parts](https://www.nicabm.com/program/fragmented-self-fisher-1): Janina Fisher's live webinar on trauma-related dissociation and fragmented parts with CE/CME credits

## Clinical Interventions for Core Issues

- [Expert Strategies for Treating Narcissism - NICABM](https://www.nicabm.com/program/narcissism): NICABM course featuring 22 top experts' practical strategies for treating narcissism and grandiosity
- [Working with the Pain of Abandonment](https://www.nicabm.com/program/abandonment): Dr. Ruth Buczynski's clinical techniques for treating abandonment trauma and building healthy relationships
- [Working With Core Beliefs of "Never Good Enough"](https://www.nicabm.com/program/never-good-enough): NICABM program with 17 expert strategies for addressing core beliefs of inadequacy in clinical practice
- [Working with the Fear of Rejection - NICABM](https://www.nicabm.com/program/rejection): NICABM webinar series on therapeutic techniques for treating fear of rejection in mental health practice
